name: Gobiosuchus
sum: Gobiosuchus is a small, gracile, armoured crocodyliform from the Late Cretaceous of the Gobi Desert, Mongolia.
wsnote: A small animal with long slender limbs; no length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not stated in the sources consulted for this draft; G. kielanae was described by Osmólska in 1972 from Bayn Dzak, Djadokhta Formation.
material: Skulls and skeletons from the Djadokhta Formation of Mongolia; a second species G. parvus is listed by PBDB.
biology: Cervical and thoracic scutes had a thickened ridge that limited flexibility; the short, tall skull had large orbits and pits in the palate to receive the sharp conical lower teeth.
author: Osmolska 1972
